Package com.shaft.gui.element.internal.interaction

package com.shaft.gui.element.internal.interaction
Shared click/type strategy layer for Selenium, Playwright, and Appium (#5732).

Waves B/C cover web kind routing. Wave D extends the same package for mobile native: focus → sendKeys / mobile: replaceElementValue / mobile: type, W3C touch click fallback, and checkbox/switch toggle semantics.

Compose: enable testTagsAsResourceId and tap before type. Flutter: prefer ValueKey/Semantics; type after focus.
